text: China Communications Construction Group (Limited) (CCCG), a wholly state-owned company, is Greentown China Holdings Limited's single largest shareholder, interested in approximately 28.88% of the company (733,456,293 shares as at 30 June 2026) through wholly-owned subsidiaries.
short: Wholly state-owned CCCG is Greentown China's single largest shareholder (~28.88%).

source.name: Greentown China Holdings Limited — Interim Report 2026 (HKEX filing via irasia.com), corporate profile and substantial shareholders' interests
source.quote: CCCG, Greentown China’s single largest shareholder, was interested in approximately 28.88% of the total issued share capital of the Company.
source.note: The substantial-shareholders table (as at 30 June 2026) lists CCCG deemed interested in 733,456,293 shares (28.881%) through CCCG Real Estate Holding Limited (100,000,000), CCCG Holding (HK) Limited (602,952,793) and CCCG (HK) Holding Limited (30,503,500), each wholly owned by CCCG. The report's definitions state: 'CCCG China Communications Construction Group (Limited), a wholly state-owned company established in the PRC and a substantial Shareholder of the Company.'

additionalSources.name: 北京商报 (Beijing Business Today): 三年计提近120亿 绿城中国进入中交系全面治理阶段
additionalSources.quote: 作为第一大股东，中交集团将为绿城中国提供更大力度的发展支持
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'As the largest shareholder, CCCG will provide Greentown China with greater development support' — a statement by CCCG party secretary/chairman Song Hailiang during his Hangzhou visit, 17 March 2026. The article repeatedly calls CCCG Greentown China's largest shareholder ('第一大股东') and describes the CCCG system taking over Greentown's governance, including the appointment of CCCG veteran Geng Zhongqiang as acting CEO after the 2025 annual report. The percentage stake is in Greentown China's own filing; the 中房网 piece (news.qq.com/rain/a/20260206A04U2600, Feb 2026) put CCCG at 28.94%.
